page.overview:
Who is Jibiki?

Jibiki dislikes quiet waters, preferring a rough, violent sea over a quiet, peaceful one. He is very committed by nature, pushing himself well into exhaustion to complete his mission. He believed that any attempts to negotiate with the enemies would be futile, and reported to Araumi in hopes of persuading Isari to stop his secret plan to barter with the Mizukage. Nevertheless, Jibiki is loyal to Isari enough to accompany him on the negotiations, and blamed himself for not stopping his superior when Araumi killed him for the perceived treason.

Jibiki is a fairly tall man with a pale complexion and narrow, grey eyes and small eyebrows. He has long, straight dark blue hair with flat bangs and a lock of hair hanging against the left side of his face and tied with an anchor-shaped clip. He wears a white poncho with a light purple cowl around his neck and grey pants.

Jibiki has a proficiency in Water Release, able to create a flowing stream of water to detect and locate various targets. He is a Sensor Type, having his skills in it noted as being unmatched by Isari.

Jibiki arrived at Kirigakure by night in Isari's fleet. During an organised diversion by exploding a series of blimps at the Kirigakure's presentation of their new generators, Jibiki joined his clan to break into prison to free their clan leader. They succeeded in rescuing Araumi, and returned to their clan, who had used the chaos to take control of several Land of Water islands.
